statement: The verifier this component emits MUST refuse a token whose payload holds an unpaired Unicode surrogate escape, and it MUST NOT expose that value as an identity field.

title: Stop cancels an active retrieval
statement: Stop on the key source this component emits MUST cancel a key retrieval that is already running, and MUST deny the request that started it.

title: An empty key source fails closed
statement: A zero value of the key source this component emits MUST deny every token, and Stop on that value MUST be safe.

title: Grant documents are strict
statement: The grant document reader this component emits MUST refuse an unknown, repeated, absent, miscased, null or coerced member, invalid Unicode, a trailing document and more than 262,144 bytes.

title: Grant bounds and uniqueness
statement: The grant policy this component emits MUST refuse a repeated grant, more than 1,024 grants, an empty issuer or subject, an oversize target, and a resource or operation name outside its character set.

title: An empty or literal wildcard target is exact
statement: The grant policy this component emits MUST treat an empty target and a literal asterisk target as exact values, and MUST NOT let either match another target.

title: The verifier is safe for concurrent use
statement: The verifier this component emits MUST give the same verified identity to concurrent callers.

title: No middleware on the runtime data path
statement: On the runtime data path this component MUST declare no middleware and the compiler MUST NOT generate its package: the verifier of the runtime library takes its place and takes the settings that the declaration states for jwt-auth. The Product owner decided on 2026-11-11.

title: A fixed key with no discovery
statement: This component MUST serve a provider whose keys come from a fixed key file or key URL, with no discovery document, and MUST verify through the verifier of the runtime library (ST-SUP-RP13); a provider with a discovery document uses oidc-auth (ST-SUP-RC37). The Product owner decided on 2026-11-11 that sign-in on the runtime data path supports any OpenID Connect provider; the new component and rh-sso-auth as its configuration are the orchestrator's design under the owner's delegation.

title: Only an access token is accepted
statement: The verifier this component emits MUST refuse, after the signature and claim checks and with an error that names no claim, a token that holds a claim that marks an ID token or a logout token (at_hash, c_hash, nonce or events), and a token that holds the payload claim typ with any value other than the JSON string Bearer, the value of a Keycloak access token: null, another JSON type, another case, and every other kind such as ID, Refresh, Logout or Offline. A token with no payload typ is not refused for it. A token of another kind is not a grant of access to the API. Follow-up of the security review of PR #202, taken by the follow-up worker, 2026-11-12; the allow list is ST-SUP-Q112, decided by the orchestrator under the Product owner's delegation, 2026-11-12.

title: kafka-producer emits no code, and needs the outbox
statement: This component MUST emit no file, no module requirement and no constructor: the Kafka destination of the runtime outbox publishes each change event (ST-SUP-RP01-LC30 to ST-SUP-RP01-LC32), the outbox registers it on its worker (ST-SUP-RC18-OC31), and each generated write stages its change event (ST-SUP-RC20-OC40). It MUST refuse a service with no outbox component, whose worker delivers the events. The owner decided ST-SUP-Q103 (a) on 2026-11-11: services publish their change events to Kafka through the runtime outbox.

title: Token proof uses the shared verifier
statement: The provider this component emits MUST verify a service-account token with the shared JWT verifier, and MUST use signing keys from the configured issuer only.

title: The token claims must match the saved policy exactly
statement: The provider this component emits MUST refuse a service-account token whose subject, client, audience set, role arrays or signed lifetime differs from the saved policy.

title: No extra or duplicate audience
statement: The provider this component emits MUST refuse a service-account token that holds an extra audience, a duplicate audience or a non-string audience.

title: The grant response must hold an access token only
statement: The provider this component emits MUST refuse a client-credentials response that holds a refresh token, an ID token, or a token type other than Bearer.

title: An unsafe client gets no credential
statement: The provider this component emits MUST NOT read or release a client secret for a public client, a disabled client, or a client whose dedicated subject is absent.

title: Ownership is checked again before the grant
statement: The provider this component emits MUST stop the operation with its ownership error when the ownership attributes change during that operation.

title: Browser callbacks are exact HTTPS URLs
statement: The provider this component emits MUST refuse a browser callback that is not an exact HTTPS URL with a path, and MUST refuse a wildcard, a query, a fragment, credentials, a traversal, an encoded alias, a loopback host or an ambiguous authority.

title: The logout callback shares the login origin
statement: The provider this component emits MUST require the login callback and the logout callback on the same origin.

title: A confidential browser client with PKCE S256
statement: The browser client the provider this component emits configures MUST be confidential and MUST use the authorization code flow with PKCE S256.

title: Unsafe browser drift is refused
statement: The provider this component emits MUST refuse a browser client that turns on the implicit flow, password grants, service accounts, full scope, a wildcard redirect, a wildcard web origin, plain PKCE or an unknown security attribute.

title: Verified transport to the provider
statement: The provider this component emits MUST use HTTPS to the Keycloak server and MUST NOT follow a redirect.

title: Credentials print as redacted text
statement: A credential, a client pointer and a migration plan that this component emits MUST print as redacted text for every Go formatting verb.

title: A creation is confirmed by a read of the saved ID
statement: The provider this component emits MUST confirm a client creation with a read of the saved provider ID, MUST NOT follow the Location header, and MUST NOT repeat the creation request.

title: A conflict is not adoption
statement: The provider this component emits MUST return its conflict error for a creation conflict, and MUST NOT adopt or replace the existing client.

title: A new client starts disabled
statement: A client the provider this component emits creates MUST have login disabled, no secret in the request, and every browser, password and authorization flow off.

title: Ownership binding refuses a foreign record
statement: A binding helper this component emits MUST refuse a nil client, a foreign client name, mixed legacy and current attributes, partial ownership keys and a foreign reserved key, and it MUST return its ownership error.

title: A candidate search cannot expand
statement: The client search this component emits MUST refuse an empty fragment and a SQL pattern character before any request, and a failed search MUST NOT fall back to a full scan.

title: A managed identity comes from trusted values
statement: An identity helper this component emits MUST compose the client name and the ownership attributes from the declared ids only, and MUST give every ownership key the reserved stego.owner. prefix.

title: A legacy audience name stays caller-known
statement: An audience binding helper this component emits MUST accept a caller-known stored client name for the legacy form only, and MUST require the generated name for current ownership.

title: A failed search is not repeated or widened
statement: The client search this component emits MUST make one request for one page, and MUST NOT repeat or widen a denied, null, oversize or ambiguous result.

title: An ambiguous provider response is refused
statement: The provider this component emits MUST refuse a provider response that holds a different ID, a duplicate member, invalid Unicode, trailing data or a repeated record, and it MUST report its response error.

title: An invalid administrator grant cannot authorize a request
statement: The provider this component emits MUST refuse an administrator grant that has no Bearer type or a lifetime outside 1 to 3,600 seconds, and MUST NOT send an API request with it.

title: Identifiers and pages are checked before the network
statement: The provider this component emits MUST refuse a client identifier outside its character set and a page outside its bounds before it makes any request, and every request MUST stay inside the selected realm.

title: A disable needs an explicit state
statement: The provider this component emits MUST refuse a client record that states no enabled value, and MUST NOT treat that record as disabled.

title: Credential rotation invalidates the token cache
statement: The provider this component emits MUST read its private credential file again for each grant, MUST clear a cached token after an unauthorized response, and MUST NOT replay that request.

title: Close releases every caller
statement: The provider this component emits MUST release a canceled or expired caller that waits for the token gate, and after it closes MUST refuse work with its closed error.

title: A provider span holds no request data
statement: A span the provider this component emits MUST keep the caller trace, MUST NOT send baggage or a trace state to the provider, and MUST NOT contain a client name, a provider ID, the server URL or a credential.

title: Closure is saved as intent before any provider call
statement: The lifecycle this component emits MUST save an irreversible closure intent with the known provider ID when closure is prepared, and MUST make no provider call until that save is acknowledged.

title: Deletion needs confirmed current ownership at the saved ID
statement: The lifecycle this component emits MUST delete a client only after it confirms current ownership at the saved provider ID, MUST refuse a foreign, mixed or unconfirmed owner, and MUST NOT delete when the save of the recovered binding is rejected or its acknowledgement is lost.

title: Strict field validation on writes
statement: The write requests this component emits MUST carry `fieldValidation=Strict` and MUST keep the caller's other query options.

title: Malformed write query fails before I/O
statement: The client this component emits MUST reject a malformed write path or query before it sends a request.

title: No retry of a resource write
statement: The client this component emits MUST NOT retry a resource write after a conflict or a rejection.

title: Token read for each request
statement: The client this component emits MUST read its token file again for each request and for each watch reconnect.

title: Private credential file required
statement: The client this component emits MUST refuse a token or credential file that permits execution, group write access, or any access for other users.

title: Ownership labels before an update or a delete
statement: The client this component emits MUST find every selected ownership label on an existing resource before it updates or deletes that resource.

title: UID and version preconditions
statement: The patch and delete requests this component emits MUST carry the observed UID and resource version as preconditions.

title: No write for a converged resource
statement: The create-or-update operation this component emits MUST NOT write a resource that already contains the desired state.

title: Deletion reports absence only
statement: The deletion helper this component emits MUST report completion only after the resource is absent.

title: Caller input preserved
statement: The client this component emits MUST NOT change the desired object or the change object that the caller supplies.

title: Exact numbers and one JSON object
statement: The decoder this component emits MUST keep JSON numbers as their exact text and MUST reject a response that is not exactly one JSON object.

title: Failure data limited to status metadata
statement: The errors this component emits MUST expose only the request method, the HTTP status, and the retry delay.

title: Bounded retry delay
statement: The client this component emits MUST limit a parsed `Retry-After` delay to one hour.

title: Reset before a list, replace after validation
statement: The observer this component emits MUST send a reset message before each new list and MUST send a replace message only after every page passes validation.

title: Watch uses the snapshot cursor
statement: The watch request this component emits MUST use the snapshot resource version and MUST NOT carry the list's paging options.

title: Expired history forces a new list
statement: The observer this component emits MUST start a new list after the API server reports expired watch history.

title: Access denial stops observation
statement: The observer this component emits MUST stop observation when the API server denies its list or watch request.

title: Bounded snapshot
statement: The observer this component emits MUST stop a snapshot that exceeds 10,000 objects, 64 MiB of object data, or 1,000 pages.

title: Consumer error and invalid path stop observation
statement: The observer this component emits MUST return the consumer callback's error and MUST reject a collection path that is not a canonical Kubernetes API path without a query.

title: Discovery fails closed and never caches
statement: The discovery check this component emits MUST reject invalid resource requirements before any request, MUST read discovery again for each call, and MUST fail when a required resource, kind, namespace scope, or verb is missing or duplicated.

title: Deployment availability requirements
statement: The availability check this component emits MUST require the observed generation, the exact total, updated, ready and available replica counts, no unavailable replica, and an `Available=True` condition.

title: Paused or deleting Deployment is not available
statement: The availability check this component emits MUST report a paused or deleting Deployment as not available.

title: Malformed observation is an error
statement: The availability check this component emits MUST return its resource observation error for a foreign owner, a missing identity, or a malformed count or condition.

title: Observation helpers make no network call
statement: The availability, Route admission, and TLS Secret checks this component emits MUST NOT make a network call.

title: Route requires the selected passthrough backend
statement: The Route check this component emits MUST require one TLS passthrough backend with the selected host, Service, target port, and router.

title: Route check rejects weaker exposure
statement: The Route check this component emits MUST reject path routing, a wildcard policy, an alternate backend, a disabled backend, and TLS termination at the router.

title: Missing admission is pending
statement: The Route check this component emits MUST report missing or absent router admission as pending without an error.

title: Probe after admission, then a new read
statement: The Route helper this component emits MUST call the application probe only after admission passes, and MUST read the Route again after the probe.

title: Unchanged Route identity around the probe
statement: The Route helper this component emits MUST report failure when the Route UID or resource version changes around the probe.

title: Stored name and namespace must match
statement: The create-or-update operation this component emits MUST reject a stored resource whose name or declared namespace differs from the desired object.

title: Explicit trust only
statement: The TLS Secret verifier this component emits MUST use only the caller's explicit trust pool and MUST NOT accept a trust anchor from the Secret.

title: Certificate field holds only certificates
statement: The TLS Secret verifier this component emits MUST reject a private key block, extra text, or a malformed block prefix in the certificate field.

title: One complete private-key block
statement: The TLS Secret verifier this component emits MUST require exactly one complete private-key PEM block in `tls.key`.

title: TLS failures carry no detail and respect data limits
statement: The TLS Secret verifier this component emits MUST return its resource observation error without certificate, key, hostname, or parser detail, and MUST permit at most 512 KiB of certificate data, 64 KiB of private key data, and 16 certificates.

title: Client certificate purpose
statement: The client certificate verifier this component emits MUST refuse a certificate that permits only server use.

title: Trust bundle parser
statement: The trust parser this component emits MUST reject private material, PEM headers, and text outside the certificate blocks, and MUST return a pool that does not change when the caller changes the input bytes.

title: Secret set digest covers data, not metadata
statement: The Secret set digest this component emits MUST change with the Secret names and data, and MUST NOT change with resource metadata alone.

title: Secret set validated before any write
statement: The Secret set operation this component emits MUST validate the complete desired set before it writes to Kubernetes.

title: Secret set requires exactly the stored data
statement: The Secret set operation this component emits MUST require each stored Secret to contain exactly the desired data, and MUST read every Secret again and check its UID, resource version, and data before it returns the digest.

title: Secret and credential errors carry no data
statement: The Secret and credential errors this component emits MUST NOT contain Secret data or credential data.

title: Namespace identity checked before and after
statement: The image pull operation this component emits MUST check the namespace owner labels and observed UID before and after the Secret write.

title: Credential JSON shape
statement: The credential validator this component emits MUST accept only Docker `auths` JSON for exactly the selected one through eight registries, and MUST reject repeated JSON member names, credential helpers, wildcards, paths, and schemes.

title: Credential file read on every call
statement: The credential file operation this component emits MUST read the private file on every call, so a rotated operator credential reaches Kubernetes.

title: Whole assignment validated before a watch changes
statement: The watch set this component emits MUST validate the complete assignment before it changes any watch, and MUST keep the running watches when it refuses an assignment.

title: Changed identity stops the old watch first
statement: The watch set this component emits MUST stop and join the old watch before it starts the watch for a changed namespace identity.

title: Watch and aggregate object limits
statement: The watch set this component emits MUST stop when its aggregate object limit or byte limit is exceeded, MUST NOT start more watches than its observer's watch limit, and MUST refuse an object from another namespace.

title: One baseline at a time and no silent scope retry
statement: The watch set this component emits MUST keep at most one complete list in flight, and MUST NOT retry a failed scope before a new assignment supplies it.

title: Durable Secret state is never replaced
statement: The durable Secret state helper this component emits MUST NOT replace an existing Secret or its public digest marker, and MUST withhold the Secret until the namespace annotation and the external binding both equal its data digest.

title: Namespace identity rechecked before registration
statement: The durable Secret state helper this component emits MUST read the namespace identity again before it registers the digest with the application.

title: Reads continue while watches are open
statement: The client this component emits MUST permit an ordinary request while all of its configured watch streams are open.

title: No pinned admission renderer in the output
statement: The generated output this component emits MUST NOT contain the pinned admission policy renderer or its function.

title: Consumer error stops the watch set
statement: The watch set this component emits MUST return the consumer's error, stop every watch, and then permit a new run.

title: No update of a terminating or absent resource
statement: The client this component emits MUST NOT patch or update a resource that is already being deleted, and MUST report an absent resource as an error.

title: Every key the client writes has a prefix STEGO controls
statement: Every label and annotation key that the code this component emits writes or selects by, such as allocation-profile and pinned-namespace-uid, MUST use the STEGO key prefix of ST-SUP-RC15-OC46, and none MUST use stego.dev; the move needs no migration, because no service is installed. The Product owner decided on 2026-11-11.

title: Restricted container security
statement: The Pod this component emits MUST set runAsNonRoot, and each of its containers MUST use a read-only root filesystem, MUST refuse privilege escalation, and MUST drop all Linux capabilities.

title: RuntimeDefault seccomp profile
statement: The Pod this component emits MUST select the RuntimeDefault seccomp profile.

title: No automatic token mount
statement: The ServiceAccount and the Pod this component emits MUST disable automatic service-account token mounting.

title: HTTPS health probes
statement: Every HTTP probe in the service manifest this component emits MUST use the HTTPS scheme, and MUST NOT use a plaintext scheme.

title: Fixed probe routes
statement: The service container in the manifest this component emits MUST use /livez for its startup and liveness probes, and MUST use /readyz for its readiness probe.

title: Traffic is denied by default
statement: The NetworkPolicy this component emits MUST declare both the Ingress and the Egress policy type for its workload Pods, so that traffic is denied unless a declared rule permits it.

title: DNS egress only to the declared resolver
statement: The NetworkPolicy this component emits MUST permit UDP and TCP egress to the declared DNS namespace on the declared DNS port.

title: Narrow external egress rules
statement: Each external endpoint rule in the NetworkPolicy this component emits MUST contain exactly one host IP prefix and exactly one TCP port, and MUST NOT contain a CIDR range, a hostname, a zero port, a loopback, link-local, multicast, unspecified or IPv4-mapped address.

title: Endpoint bindings must be complete
statement: The renderer this component emits MUST refuse a render that omits a required external endpoint binding, names an undeclared binding, repeats a binding or crosses a workload scope, and MUST emit no manifest for it.

title: Ingress needs an enabled port
statement: The NetworkPolicy this component emits MUST NOT contain an ingress rule for a port that the selected workload does not expose.

title: Workers have no inbound path
statement: The worker manifest this component emits MUST NOT contain a Service, a container port or an ingress rule.

title: Workers never overlap
statement: The worker Deployment this component emits MUST use the Recreate strategy and MUST NOT set a replica count, so the platform overlay decides how many run and no two generations of one worker run at once.

title: RPC Service exposes one TLS port
statement: The RPC Service this component emits MUST expose exactly one port, 9090, and MUST NOT expose the loopback monitor address.

title: RPC rollout selection
statement: The RPC Deployment this component emits MUST NOT set a replica count, and MUST use RollingUpdate with one extra Pod and zero unavailable Pods unless the declaration selects Recreate.

title: Render inputs must be exact
statement: The renderer this component emits MUST refuse an image reference without an explicit registry and a lowercase SHA-256 digest, a namespace that is not a DNS label, and a zero file group, and MUST emit no output for them.

title: Scope split keeps every object
statement: Together, the cluster manifest and the namespace manifest this component emits MUST contain the same objects as the full manifest, each MUST contain only resources of its own scope, and an unknown resource kind or a wrong namespace MUST stop the render.

title: Configuration digest changes one annotation
statement: When a caller supplies a configuration digest, the manifest this component emits MUST change only the Pod template annotation config-sha256 under the STEGO key prefix of ST-SUP-RC15-OC46, and the renderer MUST refuse a value that is not a lowercase 64-character SHA-256 digest.

title: Owner labels cannot replace generated labels
statement: The resources this component emits MUST keep every generated label, and the renderer MUST refuse an owner label that conflicts with a generated label or that uses a reserved key prefix, such as the STEGO key prefix of ST-SUP-RC15-OC46.

title: Image pull Secrets are references only
statement: The Pod this component emits MUST reference image pull Secrets by name in the selected workload's Pod template only, and MUST NOT contain a credential value.

title: Admission policies fail closed
statement: Each ValidatingAdmissionPolicy in the manifest this component emits MUST set failurePolicy Fail, and each matching ValidatingAdmissionPolicyBinding MUST use the Deny validation action.

title: The allocator cannot change its own controls
statement: The allocator ClusterRole this component emits MUST NOT grant any verb on ValidatingAdmissionPolicies or on RuntimeClasses.

title: The allocator has no Secret access
statement: The allocator ClusterRole this component emits MUST NOT grant access to Secrets.

title: Narrow NetworkPolicy permissions
statement: The allocator ClusterRole this component emits MUST limit NetworkPolicy access to get and patch on the name stego-allocation plus create and list, and MUST NOT grant update or delete.

title: Deny-all allocation policy shape
statement: For each profile that selects network isolation, the admission policy this component emits MUST require the reserved NetworkPolicy name stego-allocation, an empty Pod selector, both policy types and the complete declared rule set, and MUST NOT select a profile that did not choose isolation.

title: The control account installer is never bound
statement: The manifest this component emits MUST declare the control-account installer ClusterRole with its single non-resource capability, MUST NOT emit a ClusterRoleBinding for it, and MUST NOT give that capability to another generated object.

title: Pod policy covers status and ephemeral writes
statement: The Pod admission policy this component emits MUST apply to pods, pods/status and pods/ephemeralcontainers on CREATE and UPDATE, and MUST NOT block Pod deletion.

title: Allocated Pod account and token rule
statement: When a profile declares a Pod ServiceAccount, the Pod admission policy this component emits MUST require the allocation's sealed account name from the immutable namespace annotation, and MUST require an explicit false automountServiceAccountToken value.

title: An absent runtime class makes no claim
statement: The Pod admission policy this component emits MUST NOT contain a runtimeClassName rule when its profile declares no Pod runtime class.

title: Application Pod rules only add denials
statement: An application Pod rule in the policy this component emits MUST appear only as an added validation, and MUST NOT change the policy selector, the failure mode, the variables, the common checks or the binding.

title: Network output keys need the node identity
statement: In an isolated profile that selects the OVN node identity provider, the Pod admission policy this component emits MUST permit a change to the OVN or Multus network output annotation only through a status update from the authenticated network identity of the Pod's assigned node, and MUST reject that key on a create request.

title: Bounded container build context
statement: The Containerfile.dockerignore this component emits MUST exclude the whole build context first, MUST then permit only the module files and the declared source directories, and MUST exclude hidden files and private-key file extensions.

title: Static non-root image
statement: The Containerfile this component emits MUST build with CGO disabled from a digest-pinned builder image, MUST use a scratch runtime stage, MUST set the user 65532:65532, and MUST name explicitly the executable that the container starts.

title: Local application container isolation
statement: The browser Pod this component emits MUST give its local application container separate Secret and temporary volumes, MUST NOT expose a container port for that container, and MUST NOT share a volume with the browser container.

title: A browser deployment keeps the API restrictions
statement: The manifest this component emits for a browser-backend service MUST be byte-identical to the manifest for the equivalent API declaration, and MUST NOT add a gRPC listener or accept a gRPC ingress peer.

title: The RPC process binds TLS and a loopback monitor
statement: The RPC manifest this component emits MUST bind the gRPC listener on 9090 with its certificate and key files from the mounted file Secret, MUST set the monitor address to a loopback address, and MUST run its probes through the executable that the container starts.

title: An existing service account changes only the Pod's reference
statement: When the declaration names an existing ServiceAccount, the renderer this component emits MUST accept it only as a DNS label in namespace scope, MUST omit the generated account and every generated grant, and MUST change nothing but the Pod's serviceAccountName.

title: The service container requires TLS
statement: The service container in the manifest this component emits MUST set STEGO_HTTP_REQUIRE_TLS to 1 and MUST point the TLS certificate and key settings at the mounted key pair.

title: The base carries no namespace allocation
statement: The manifest this component emits MUST contain no ValidatingAdmissionPolicy, no policy binding and no allocation ResourceQuota, and the code it emits MUST contain no namespace allocator; a service that hands out namespaces declares the namespace-allocation component for that.

title: Egress destinations are addresses, and replies need no rule
statement: A destination this component accepts MUST be an IP address and port, never a DNS name, until a DNS-aware network provider is a declared platform requirement that STEGO itself drives; the emitted policy MUST use no Technology Preview resource; and it MUST permit the replies of an approved connection while denying every new connection the declaration does not name.

title: One Deployment per mode
statement: The manifest this component emits MUST hold one Deployment per declared mode, each with the one service image and the mode argument set to that mode.

title: Probes and grace period follow the mode
statement: Each mode's Deployment MUST carry the probe paths and the terminationGracePeriodSeconds of its mode: the HTTP readiness for api, the database readiness and the longest handler for worker, and the lease release for controller.

title: A Service for api only
statement: The manifest this component emits MUST hold a Service for the api mode and MUST NOT hold one for worker or controller.

title: Disruption budgets fit the replica count
statement: The manifest MUST hold a PodDisruptionBudget with maxUnavailable 1 for api and for worker, and MUST NOT hold one for a controller with one replica.

title: Scaling objects follow the mode and the platform
statement: The manifest MUST hold a HorizontalPodAutoscaler on CPU for api, a HorizontalPodAutoscaler for worker by default, and a KEDA ScaledObject on unclaimed outbox rows for worker only when the platform requirements declare KEDA.

title: Ingress reaches api only
statement: The NetworkPolicy this component emits MUST allow ingress to the api mode only.

title: Every key STEGO writes has a prefix STEGO controls
statement: Every label and annotation key that this component writes or reserves MUST use one key prefix, a DNS name that STEGO controls, such as for config-sha256, allocator and service-account-<alias>, and none MUST use stego.dev, which belongs to an unrelated company; the test record names the prefix, and the move needs no migration, because no service is installed. The Product owner decided on 2026-11-11.

title: Restricted Pod and container security
statement: The Pod this component emits MUST set runAsNonRoot and the RuntimeDefault seccomp profile, and each of its containers MUST set runAsNonRoot, a read-only root filesystem, no privilege escalation and a dropped set of all Linux capabilities.

title: No host access and no raw Pod field
statement: The Pod this component emits MUST NOT enable host network, host PID or host IPC access, MUST NOT contain a host path volume, a privileged container, a mount subPath or an exec probe, and MUST NOT contain an init container.

title: Token mounting is explicit
statement: The Pod this component emits MUST disable automatic service-account token mounting unless the declaration selects the Kubernetes API, and MUST NOT use the default ServiceAccount.

title: Read-only configuration mounts
statement: Each Secret or ConfigMap volume in the Pod this component emits MUST be mounted read-only, and a Secret volume MUST use file mode 0440.

title: Only bounded ephemeral volumes
statement: The Pod this component emits MUST NOT contain a volume other than a Secret, a ConfigMap or a bounded emptyDir, and the sum of its emptyDir limits MUST NOT exceed the Pod's total ephemeral storage limit.

title: Three HTTP probes for each container
statement: Each container in the Pod this component emits MUST declare a startup, a readiness and a liveness HTTP probe, each probe port MUST belong to that same container, and a probe path MUST NOT contain a host, credentials, a query or a fragment.

title: Digest-pinned container images
statement: Each container image in the Deployment this component emits MUST name a registry, an image path in that registry and a lowercase SHA-256 digest, and a tag without a digest MUST NOT be accepted.

title: Configuration digest annotation
statement: The Pod template this component emits MUST carry the annotation config-sha256 under the STEGO key prefix of ST-SUP-RC15-OC46 computed from the declared dependency contents, and a change of those contents MUST change only that annotation.

title: No dependency contents in the output
statement: The resources this component emits MUST NOT contain dependency contents or Secret values, and a Secret environment value MUST appear only as a secretKeyRef name and key.

title: Dependencies match mounts and environment exactly
statement: The Deployment this component emits MUST use exactly the ConfigMaps and Secrets that its volume mounts and Secret environment references name, and a Secret environment key MUST exist in that Secret's declared contents.

title: A ClusterIP Service targets a declared port
statement: The Service this component emits MUST be a ClusterIP Service whose ports target a declared container port, and no Service MUST be emitted when the declaration names no service port.

title: An omitted profile field is removed explicitly
statement: The Deployment this component emits MUST use an explicit JSON null for each field that this profile owns and the declaration omits, so that a merge patch removes an old value.

title: Requests are positive and within limits
statement: Each container in the Deployment this component emits MUST declare positive CPU, memory and ephemeral storage requests that do not exceed its own limits, in the canonical API units.

title: RollingUpdate keeps one extra replica
statement: A RollingUpdate Deployment this component emits MUST use one extra replica and zero unavailable replicas.

title: A span holds no private request data
statement: A span the runtime this component emits exports MUST NOT contain a request path, a query value, a request body, a response body, an Authorization header, baggage or a trace state.

title: Instrumentation does not change the response
statement: The handler wrapper this component emits MUST keep the status, the body and the flush behavior of the application response.

title: An HTTPS collector origin only
statement: The runtime this component emits MUST refuse a collector endpoint that is not a plain HTTPS origin, and MUST refuse credentials, a path or a query in that endpoint.

title: No undeclared telemetry setting
statement: The runtime this component emits MUST refuse an OTEL environment setting that its allowlist does not hold.

title: A bounded sampling ratio
statement: The runtime this component emits MUST refuse a trace sampling ratio that is not a real number from 0 to 1.

title: The collector certificate is verified
statement: The runtime this component emits MUST verify the collector certificate against the configured roots with TLS 1.3 or later, and MUST NOT export to an untrusted collector.

title: No proxy for export
statement: The runtime this component emits MUST NOT send its export through an HTTP proxy.

title: A blocked collector cannot reach the request
statement: A collector that does not answer MUST NOT change, delay or stop a request that the runtime this component emits observes.

title: A bounded shutdown
statement: The runtime this component emits MUST finish shutdown inside its shutdown limit, also when the collector does not answer.

title: The collector token protects every signal
statement: The runtime this component emits MUST attach the collector token to every trace, log and metric export.

title: Token rotation applies without a restart
statement: The runtime this component emits MUST read the token file again for each export, so a replaced token applies without a restart.

title: The token file must be private
statement: The runtime this component emits MUST refuse a collector token file that group or other users can read.

title: An opaque instance identity
statement: The resource the runtime this component emits MUST hold a random UUID v4 in service.instance.id, and that value MUST NOT contain a host name, a pod name, a process ID, a file path or a credential.

title: An entropy failure stops the runtime
statement: The runtime this component emits MUST fail its creation with fixed error text when the random source returns an error or a short read.

title: A remote sampled flag cannot override a zero ratio
statement: The runtime this component emits MUST NOT record a span for an incoming sampled parent when the local sampling ratio is zero.

title: An invalid parent starts a root span
statement: The runtime this component emits MUST start a root span when the incoming trace parent is absent, malformed, all zero or repeated.

title: Bounded metric cardinality
statement: The metric provider this component emits MUST limit each instrument to 128 series.

title: An active counter returns to zero
statement: The active request counter the runtime this component emits MUST return to zero when every observed call completes.

title: Each runtime has a distinct identity
statement: Two runtimes this component emits MUST hold distinct instance identities, also when they share a service name, and a close MUST NOT change an identity.

title: Every signal and local log carry the runtime identity
statement: The traces, logs, metrics and local JSON output the runtime this component emits MUST all carry that runtime's service name and instance identity.

title: A handler panic invents no response
statement: The runtime this component emits MUST NOT record an HTTP status for a handler that panics, MUST re-raise that panic, and MUST NOT put the panic value in a signal.

title: A panic leaves no active request
statement: The runtime this component emits MUST return its active request counter to zero after a handler panics.

title: Local log output stays bounded
statement: The local log queue the runtime this component emits MUST NOT block its caller, and it MUST drop records beyond its bound and count those drops.

title: Outbound RPC signals stay isolated
statement: An outbound RPC signal the runtime this component emits MUST start a child of the caller span, MUST send a trace parent without baggage or a trace state, MUST NOT change the caller metadata, and MUST NOT export private call data.

title: Database signals exclude the statement
statement: A database signal the runtime this component emits MUST NOT contain SQL text, an argument or a connection detail, and an unknown outcome MUST become a fixed fallback value.

title: Deployment export holds no private value
statement: The deployment export this component emits MUST return fixed relative file names with the validated settings, MUST NOT put a token or a source path in the environment or in an error, and MUST read the files again for each call.

title: Outbound HTTPS signals stay isolated
statement: An outbound HTTPS signal the runtime this component emits MUST start a child of the caller span, MUST NOT send baggage or a trace state, MUST NOT change the caller headers, and MUST NOT export private call data.

title: Unsupported signal settings are refused
statement: The runtime this component emits MUST refuse an exporter value other than otlp or none, and a metric export interval outside 1,000 to 60,000 milliseconds.

title: Blocked signal collectors do not accumulate shutdown budgets
statement: The runtime this component emits MUST close every signal provider inside one shared shutdown limit, also when no collector answers.

title: An invalid service name is refused and not echoed
statement: The runtime this component emits MUST refuse a service name that is longer than 128 bytes or outside its character set, and MUST NOT put that value in the error.

title: Service events go through the probe runtime
statement: The runtime this component emits MUST send its fixed service events (telemetry.runtime.started, telemetry.runtime.stopped, service.ready, service.stopping, service.failed and http.server.diagnostic) only as the built-in observations of the probe runtime (ST-SUP-RP12-LC21), so they always reach the console sink on standard output in their fixed form, with or without a collector and whatever STEGO_PROBE_CONSOLE says (ST-SUP-RP12-LC22), and reach OTLP too when a collector endpoint is set.

title: No sanctioned signal goes to standard error
statement: The runtime this component emits MUST write no signal of its own to standard error, also when no collector endpoint is set and STEGO_PROBE_CONSOLE is off, so its service events go to standard output (ST-SUP-RC17-OC31) and standard error carries only the debug hatch of ST-EXT-UC01-R06.

title: A repeated message ID stops the write
statement: The queue MUST refuse a message ID that it already holds, and MUST make the caller's transaction fail.

title: Worker mode dispatches in process
statement: In worker mode the outbox this component emits MUST dispatch claimed rows to the destination handlers in the same process, with no broker, and this component MUST provide the durable-outbox port.

title: Exhausted retries are parked as dead letters in the queue table
statement: The migration this component emits MUST NOT create a separate dead-letter table: a dead letter is a parked message in the queue table, with the state it left and its last error code; a message whose retries are exhausted MUST be parked there and MUST NOT hold back another key.

title: Every destination the registry offers is idempotent
statement: Every destination handler that a registry component registers on the emitted outbox MUST be registered as idempotent and MUST be safe to run twice for one row, because the relay can crash after acting and before recording the fact; the one exception is a partner HTTPS destination whose partner does not accept an Idempotency-Key, which MUST be registered as not idempotent, so its unknown outcomes are reconciled or parked and never sent again (ST-SUP-RC36-OC01).

title: The outbox is tenant-scoped
statement: The outbox table this component emits MUST carry tenant_id, MUST have row-level security enabled and forced with the tenant policy and the relay policy of ST-SUP-RP01-LC19, and MUST order and lock messages by the tenant, the destination and the resource key together (ST-SUP-RP01-LC03); a message MUST carry the tenant so a downstream service sets it again.

title: The outbox table counts conflicts apart from attempts
statement: The outbox table this component emits MUST hold, for each message, a conflict count apart from its attempt count, and the emitted relay MUST handle a conflict that a consumer returns as ST-SUP-RP01-LC18 states: it MUST NOT increase the attempt count, and MUST wait from 100 ms up to 30 s before the next dispatch, for each of the first 20 conflicts in a row, and MUST count each further conflict in a row as a failed attempt.

title: The queue table is the runtime outbox's
statement: This component MUST NOT create stego_outbox.messages itself: the queue table, its policies and its relay functions come from the runtime outbox migration (ST-SUP-RP01-LC19), and this component emits only the destination registrations and the worker wiring on the outbox runtime (ST-SUP-RP01). The owner delegated this decision to the orchestrator (2026-11-09). The Product owner decided ST-SUP-Q103 (a) on 2026-11-11: kafka-producer becomes a destination of the runtime outbox, and the slot on_entity_changed runs as an after slot through the outbox (ST-SUP-RC20-OC34). With the kafka-producer component, the worker gets the Kafka destination of the runtime (ST-SUP-RC18-OC31).

title: With kafka-producer, the worker gets the Kafka destination of the runtime
statement: When the service has the kafka-producer component, this component MUST name the destination kafka among the destinations of the service and MUST register on the worker, in NewWorker, the Kafka destination of the runtime (ST-SUP-RP01-LC30 to ST-SUP-RP01-LC32): kafkaoutbox.New with the settings that kafkaoutbox.ReadSettings reads from the process environment and the log provider of the worker's configuration, so the events of kafka.delivery_failed reach the telemetry of the service. A setting that the destination cannot use MUST stop NewWorker, so the worker mode does not start without its Kafka settings. It MUST emit no Kafka client, no grant and no module requirement of its own. The owner decided ST-SUP-Q103 (a) on 2026-11-11: services publish their change events to Kafka through the runtime outbox.

title: The environment selects nothing
statement: The client this component emits MUST take its host, port, user, database, password and certificate trust only from its Options, and MUST refuse a PGSERVICE value.

title: A read session is read-only
statement: The client MUST open each read session with read-only transaction defaults, pg_catalog as its search path, and explicit statement and lock limits.

title: Verified TLS only
statement: The client MUST verify the server certificate against the supplied trust and against the Options host name, and MUST NOT fall back to plaintext or to unverified TLS.

title: The trust input holds certificates only
statement: The client MUST refuse a certificate input that contains a private key or trailing data, and MUST refuse an incomplete connection identity.

title: Checks come before the connection
statement: A single-row read MUST check its context, its query size, its argument values, its argument types and its scan destinations before it opens a connection.

title: An error keeps the server's words out
statement: A returned Error MUST contain only an operation stage and a validated SQLSTATE, and MUST NOT contain the server message, the query, the arguments or the password.

title: The caller's deadline wins
statement: A single-row read MUST end within its own six-second limit, or within the caller's shorter deadline.

title: A read changes nothing
statement: A single-row read MUST refuse a write statement through its read-only session, and MUST leave the database unchanged.

title: A login reaches only its own database
statement: Ensuring a database MUST refuse to enable an application login while that login can connect to another database on the server.

title: Owner and login are separate
statement: The database owner role MUST NOT be able to log in, and the application login MUST NOT hold administrative attributes, role memberships or the right to grant database access.

title: Only recorded objects change
statement: The runtime MUST refuse an object whose recorded identity differs from the server's, and MUST NOT adopt or drop an unrecorded database or role.

title: One operation for each resource
statement: The runtime MUST hold a session lock for each resource key, and MUST return its database-busy error instead of a second concurrent operation on that resource.

title: No global providers
statement: The client MUST emit its signals only through the telemetry runtime in the caller's context, and MUST NOT use global providers or the default logger.

title: Signals carry no private value
statement: The client's spans, metrics and logs MUST carry only fixed fields such as the operation and the outcome, and MUST NOT carry a query, an argument, a resource key, a database name, a host or a credential.

title: A prepared credential stays out of logs
statement: Formatting a prepared credential MUST omit its server identity and its password, and implicit JSON export MUST fail.

title: SQL names come from the resource keys
statement: The runtime MUST derive its SQL names from the resource keys, MUST NOT accept a caller-supplied SQL identifier, and MUST refuse an empty key, a key with a NUL byte and a key over 256 bytes.

title: Schema work needs a ready, pinned database
statement: Running schema work as the database owner MUST refuse a missing context, a missing callback, an unpinned server, an unmanaged database and an invalid credential before it runs schema code.

title: One lifecycle for every server, with no raised authority
statement: The lifecycle this component emits MUST serve every supplied PostgreSQL server through one SQL path with no provider branch, MUST reuse the recorded identity when a step is retried, and MUST NOT disable a server control or raise its own authority.

title: Problem responses use the problem media type
statement: Each error response the handlers this component emits write MUST use the content type application/problem+json and MUST carry the RFC 9457 members type, title, status, detail and code.

title: Each problem names its path, its time and its trace
statement: Each problem response MUST set instance from the request path, timestamp as a UTC RFC 3339 value, and trace_id from the Traceparent header when the request carries one.

title: Error codes carry the service prefix and the category
statement: Each problem response MUST carry a code of the form SERVICEPREFIX-CATEGORY-NUMBER, and the category MUST be VAL, AUT, AUZ, NTF, CNF or INT to match the response status.

title: The problem type is the declared base or about:blank
statement: The problem type MUST be the declared error type base joined to the category slug, and MUST be about:blank when the service declares no base.

title: A validation failure lists its fields
statement: A 400 validation problem MUST carry a validation_errors array with one field name and one message for each request member that failed, up to 50 entries; when more members failed, it MUST list 50 of them and one more entry that says how many it does not list. An entry MUST NOT quote a value of the request.

title: A single resource carries its envelope metadata
statement: In envelope mode each single-resource response MUST carry id, kind and href beside the entity's own JSON members.

title: A list carries its paging envelope
statement: In envelope mode each list response MUST carry kind as the entity name joined to List, the returned item count as size, the presented items, and next, the cursor of the next page, when there is one; it carries no total count (ST-SUP-RC20-OC38). Decided by orchestrator under owner delegation, 2026-11-12 (single data path, RC20-OC39 PR 2): the clause of the store path is removed with that path.

title: Identifiers are time-ordered
statement: In envelope mode a create or upsert handler MUST assign a new UUID version 7 identifier and MUST NOT use a version 4 identifier.

title: Paging has fixed defaults and a hard cap
statement: A list handler MUST use pageSize 100 when the request omits it, MUST answer 400 for a pageSize that is not a whole number of at least 1, MUST clamp pageSize to at most the limit of the query runtime, and pages by the sealed cursor of ST-SUP-RC20-OC38. Decided by orchestrator under owner delegation, 2026-11-12 (single data path, RC20-OC39 PR 2): the clause of the store path is removed with that path.

title: Ordering uses only entity fields
statement: A list handler MUST answer 400 for an orderBy field name that is not an entity field and for any direction other than asc or desc (ST-SUP-RC20-OC38). Decided by orchestrator under owner delegation, 2026-11-12 (single data path, RC20-OC39 PR 2): the clause of the store path is removed with that path.

title: The default order is newest first
statement: A list handler MUST order by created_time descending when the request supplies no orderBy, with the key as the last tie-breaker (ST-SUP-RC20-OC38). Decided by orchestrator under owner delegation, 2026-11-12 (single data path, RC20-OC39 PR 2): the clause of the store path is removed with that path.

title: Field selection is checked and keeps the identifier
statement: A list handler MUST answer 400 for a fields value that is not an entity field, and MUST keep id in the selection even when the request omits it.

title: Upsert reports an insert and an update apart
statement: An upsert handler MUST answer 201 when the generated upsert command inserted a row and 200 when it updated one. Owner decision of 2026-11-09: generated CRUD runs on the command and query runtime, one data path. On the runtime data path an upsert MUST find its stored row by its scope field, its implicit fields and its upsert key, also when the upsert key names none of them, and MUST answer not found for a stored row of another parent or implicit value; the unique index of the upsert key MUST hold the same fields, so an insert under one parent never meets the row of another. The validate gate MUST decide the requested value before the lookup, with no server-managed field set, because the branch is not known yet (the insert sets them after the lookup), and on_entity_changed MUST be staged after the write, on the insert and on the update. An entity with no required reference to an entity with a resource type MUST declare create public with a reason, because an optional reference that the body leaves out decides nothing. Decision of 2026-11-11 by the orchestrator, under the Product owner's delegation, in the security review of PR #212. The gate sees no server-managed field: decided by orchestrator under owner delegation, 2026-11-12 (follow-up L1 of PR #212).

title: A stale or missing If-Match precondition is refused
statement: An upsert handler on a collection that declares optimistic concurrency MUST take the generation that the client last read from an If-Match header, one strong entity tag that holds the decimal generation, such as "3". When the row of the key is stored, the handler MUST answer 428 with no change when the request sends no If-Match, MUST answer 412 with no change when the If-Match is not of that form or names another generation than the stored one, and on a match MUST update the row and raise its generation by one (ST-SUP-RC20-OC18). When no row of the key is stored, the handler MUST first decide the permission that the insert decides, edit of each required parent through its reference, MUST answer 404 with the outcome denied when that is denied, as for a stored row that the caller may not upsert, and only then MUST answer 412 with no change for a request with an If-Match; a request without one inserts the row. So the If-Match tells no caller that a row of the key exists (ST-SUP-RC20-OC37, ST-SUP-RP10-LC31). The entity MUST have a required generation field of type int32 or int64 and a required reference with a permission, or generation is refused. Owner decision of 2026-11-09: generated CRUD runs on the command and query runtime, one data path. Decided by orchestrator under owner delegation, 2026-11-11 (ST-SUP-Q105 b). Decided by orchestrator under owner delegation, 2026-11-12 (delta security recheck of PR #215, D1).

title: Patch changes only the fields the request supplies
statement: A patch handler MUST accept only the collection's patchable fields, MUST take each one as a pointer, and MUST leave every other stored field unchanged.

title: Patch refreshes its update fields
statement: A patch handler MUST set updated_by from the verified identity, and MUST set updated_time to the time of the change.

title: Client values for server-managed fields are discarded
statement: A create, update or upsert handler MUST clear the client values of computed fields, timestamp fields, created_by, updated_by and generation, and MUST then set them from the server. On a collection with optimistic concurrency the client names the generation it last read in the If-Match header of an upsert, never in the body (ST-SUP-RC20-OC14). Decided by orchestrator under owner delegation, 2026-11-11 (ST-SUP-Q105 b).

title: An update keeps create-only values and raises the generation
statement: An update handler MUST restore created_by, created_time and computed fields from the stored record, and MUST raise generation from the stored value by one.

title: A wrong kind is refused
statement: A create, update, upsert or patch handler MUST answer 400 when the request body carries a kind member that is not the entity name, and MUST accept a body that omits kind.

title: Request schemas hide fields the client cannot set
statement: The OpenAPI document this component emits MUST leave server-managed fields, scope fields, implicit fields and id out of each create-request schema.

title: Bodies are checked against the emitted document
statement: When request validation is openapi-schema, the middleware this component emits MUST check every POST, PUT and PATCH body against the embedded OpenAPI document and MUST answer a 400 validation problem when the check fails. Before the check, it MUST count the JSON values and member names of the body, with each number read as text, and MUST refuse with a 400 validation problem a body that holds more than 10000 of them, and with a 400 problem a body that is not JSON, so the check cannot build a failure for each of a large number of values and no error of the count lets a body pass. The orchestrator restated this contract under the Product owner's delegation on 2026-11-13, for the security review lows S2 of #273 and the medium of #278.

title: Validation gives the body back to the handler
statement: The validation middleware MUST restore the request body for the handler after it reads the body for the check.

title: Implicit fields are forced
statement: A create or upsert handler MUST overwrite the collection's implicit fields with their declared constant values, and a list handler MUST filter on those values.

title: A scoped record is checked against its parent
statement: A read, update, patch or delete handler on a scoped collection MUST check that the stored record belongs to the parent named in the request path before it answers.

title: Discovery endpoints need no token
statement: This component MUST emit GET routes for the OpenAPI document, an OpenAPI HTML page and the service metadata, and MUST register them outside the authenticated route group.

title: The metadata names the service and its top collections
statement: The metadata response this component emits MUST carry kind API, the service name as id, the base path as href, and one entry for each unscoped collection.

title: Cross-origin headers come from the environment
statement: When CORS is enabled, the middleware this component emits MUST read the allowed origins, methods and headers from the environment; with no allowed origin it MUST set no CORS header and MUST pass every request, OPTIONS too, to the handler; with allowed origins it MUST compare the request Origin with each, MUST echo only the one that matches in the allow-origin header with Vary: Origin, and MUST answer an OPTIONS preflight with 204. The orchestrator decided this on 2026-11-11 under the Product owner delegation of that day, option (a) of ST-SUP-Q112.

title: Every route begins at the base path
statement: Every route and every OpenAPI path this component emits MUST begin with the service base path, and MUST start at the root when the service declares no base path.

title: A successful body is JSON
statement: Each successful response body this component emits MUST carry the application/json content type.

title: A before slot can stop the request
statement: When a before slot returns a refusal, the handler MUST answer with the slot's status as a problem response and MUST NOT run the generated command. Owner decision of 2026-11-09: generated CRUD runs on the command and query runtime, one data path.

title: An unbound slot is a passthrough
statement: A handler MUST NOT call a slot that the service did not bind, and MUST continue the request as if the slot accepted it.

title: A delete answers with no content
statement: A delete handler MUST answer 204 and MUST write no response body.

title: Routes are literal method-and-pattern registrations
statement: The wiring this component emits MUST register each declared collection operation as one Go method-and-pattern route with a string literal pattern.

title: An after slot runs only after a successful store call
statement: A handler MUST call an after slot only after its generated command committed, and MUST NOT call it when that operation failed. Owner decision of 2026-11-09: generated CRUD runs on the command and query runtime, one data path. On the runtime data path each after slot MUST run through the outbox: the handler stages it in the transaction of the command, so it runs only after the command committed, the outbox retries a failure, and a failure never reaches the answer; every failure and every retry of an after slot MUST be visible to the operator, as a metric that holds the slot name and a log line that holds the slot name and no error text. The Product owner decided on 2026-11-11.

title: The tenant comes from the verified identity
statement: Every route this component emits MUST take the tenant from the verified identity, and MUST NOT accept a tenant from a header, a query parameter or a body field.

title: A slot fill gets its binding's probe
statement: Each handler this component emits MUST bind, in the context it passes each bound slot fill, the probe that the domain-probe component (ST-SUP-RC34) generates for that slot binding, bound to the call's span context, tenant, principal and binding name, and MUST NOT change the slot's protobuf contract to do so (ST-SUP-INV14).

title: Each collection operation is one generated command or query
statement: Each declared collection operation MUST be generated as one command on the command runtime (ST-SUP-RP10) (create, update, upsert, patch, delete) or one query on the query runtime (ST-SUP-RP11) (read, list), and its handler MUST call that command's or query's Run. The handlers this component emits MUST NOT open a database connection, hold a store or call one; the collection's bound slots (before, gate, after and fan-out) MUST run as fills around the generated command or query, in the order the slot contracts state, so tenancy, idempotency, audit and authorization are applied once, by the runtime. Owner decision of 2026-11-09: generated CRUD runs on the command and query runtime, one data path. The Product owner decided on 2026-11-11 that the runtime data path is the only data path: no new work goes into the store path, and the store path, the data_path switch and the protections for GORM ledgers are removed when the trigger of ST-SUP-RC20-OC39 holds; the store records are retired with that code.

title: A list on the runtime data path pages by cursor and orders by declared fields
statement: On the runtime data path a list MUST answer the cursor envelope, with kind as the entity name joined to List, size, the items and next, the sealed cursor text of the next page, and no total count; MUST read pageSize and cursor; MUST order by one or more declared fields of the entity that the request names in orderBy, each asc or desc, in the default order of ST-SUP-RC20-OC11 when it names none, and always with the key as the last tie-breaker, so that the cursor stays stable; and MUST answer 400 for an orderBy field that is not a declared field and for any other direction. The Product owner decided on 2026-11-11 that the order by declared fields comes now, not later.

title: The store path is removed once the runtime data path has what it needs
statement: The store path, the data_path switch of the record and the protections for the ledgers of a GORM release MUST be removed, with their records, in the first change after all of these hold: the runtime data path serves gRPC (ST-SUP-RC07-OC19), it runs the background workers (ST-SUP-RC35), it signs in through the oidc-auth verifier with rh-sso-auth on it (ST-SUP-RC37, ST-SUP-RC21-OC15), it orders a list by declared fields (ST-SUP-RC20-OC38), and every archetype and every example is on it; until then no new work MUST go into the store path. The Product owner decided on 2026-11-11 that the runtime data path is the only data path. The Product owner decided ST-SUP-Q100 (a) on 2026-11-11: command, query, domain-probe, tenancy, spicedb-authz and audit-log become ga in new versions, and the owner waives the graduation evidence of ST-SUP-INV07 for them, because they are the only data path, proved by end-to-end tests and security reviews. The Product owner decided ST-SUP-Q103 (a) on 2026-11-11: kafka-producer becomes a destination of the runtime outbox and on_entity_changed runs as an after slot through the outbox; until that destination is built the examples do not use the event-publisher mixin. Decisions of 2026-11-11 by the orchestrator, under the Product owner's delegation: ST-SUP-Q101 (a), a service that declares no entity, no command and no query has no data access and gets no runtime wiring; ST-SUP-Q104 (a), rpc-service holds grpc-application with postgres-adapter, command, query, domain-probe and outbox in place of grpc-processes.

title: With kafka-producer, each write stages its change event in its command
statement: When the service has the kafka-producer component, the generated command of each collection write MUST declare the destination kafka, idempotent and not must land (ST-SUP-RP01-LC31), with the names of the events that it stages, and its fill MUST stage one change event after its write, in the transaction of the command, for the written row: so the event is sent only after the command committed, never after a replay or a before slot that halted the command, and it waits in the outbox while the broker is down. The name of the event MUST be the service name, the entity name in lower-case words joined by hyphens and the action, joined by periods, such as user-management.org-setting.updated; with no declared topic the Kafka destination sends every event of one entity to the topic <service>.<entity>, so the actions of one row keep their order (ST-SUP-RP01-LC30): The orchestrator decided this on 2026-11-12 under the owner's delegation (ST-SUP-Q115 (a), security review of PR #233). The action MUST be created for a create and for an upsert that inserts, updated for an update, a patch and an upsert that updates, and deleted for a delete. The payload MUST be the JSON object of the entity name, the action and the ID of the row, and no field value, so no pii or secret field leaves the service in an event. Generation MUST refuse a service without the outbox component, and an event name that is not an outbox message kind and a Kafka topic name. The owner decided ST-SUP-Q103 (a) on 2026-11-11: services publish their change events to Kafka through the runtime outbox. The orchestrator decided ST-SUP-Q114 (a) on 2026-11-12 under the owner's delegation: a change event carries no field value now; a declared opt-in per collection can come later if a consumer needs it.

title: A list that names the caller's write waits for it
statement: On the runtime data path the emitted list handler MUST call AwaitWrite (ST-SUP-RP11-LC21) after it read the request and before it opens the read, so a list with the header Authz-Revocation-After that names the caller's own revocation waits for it within the wait cap and answers its state in Authz-Revocation, and then shows the write; it MUST answer 400 to a value that AwaitWrite refuses as a bad request (ST-SUP-Q119).

title: A read that names the caller's write waits for it
statement: On the runtime data path the emitted read handler MUST call AwaitWrite (ST-SUP-RP11-LC21) after it read the request and before it opens the read, as the list handler does (ST-SUP-RC20-OC41), so a read with the header Authz-Revocation-After that names the caller's own revocation waits for it within the wait cap and answers its state in Authz-Revocation, and then shows the write; it MUST answer 400 to a value that AwaitWrite refuses as a bad request (ST-SUP-Q119).

title: The OpenAPI document describes the revocation headers and the status route
statement: The OpenAPI document of the rest-api component MUST describe, on each read and list, the optional request headers Authz-Revocation-After and Prefer, a 400 response, and the response header Authz-Revocation with the states pending, complete, parked, failed, expired and unknown; on each write, the response headers Authz-Revocation (pending) and Authz-Revocation-Location of each success response, which a write sends only when it enqueued a tuple; and the revocation status route of ST-SUP-RC29-OC18, outside the base path, with the path parameter id, the header Prefer, at the path that spicedb-authz registers (ST-SUP-RC29-OC18), a 200 response with the headers Authz-Revocation and Preference-Applied and a body of id and state only, each with the states pending, complete, parked, failed and expired, and a 404 response (ST-SUP-Q119, ST-SUP-RC29-OC16 to OC19). The orchestrator decided on 2026-11-14 under the Product owner's delegation that the document lists expired, which authz.Status answers (#290 review R1).

title: Trust comes before claim mapping
statement: The SSO handler this component emits MUST verify the token through the shared JWT verifier before it maps any SSO claim.

title: A wrong issuer, audience or expiry is denied
statement: The SSO handler this component emits MUST answer 401 for a signed token that has a wrong issuer, a wrong audience or no expiry.

title: Public paths are exact
statement: The SSO handler this component emits MUST let an unauthenticated request through only on an exact configured public path, and MUST NOT give a subpath that access.

title: Stop closes the handler
statement: After Stop, the SSO handler this component emits MUST deny every later request, and a repeat Stop MUST be safe.

title: The SSO denial response is safe
statement: A denial from the SSO handler this component emits MUST NOT contain the token, and MUST set Cache-Control to no-store with a WWW-Authenticate header.

title: The claim order is fixed
statement: The SSO handler this component emits MUST fill each payload field from its declared claim order only.

title: Claim mapping grants no role
statement: The identity the SSO handler this component emits MUST hold an empty Role, because SSO claim mapping does not grant resource access.

title: The identity holds the verified subject
statement: The identity this component emits MUST hold the verified issuer in Identity.Issuer and the verified subject in Identity.UserID.

title: Startup needs explicit trust
statement: The SSO handler this component emits MUST refuse to start when the issuer or the audience is not set, or when the initial key load fails.

title: There is no authentication-disable mode
statement: The SSO handler this component emits MUST refuse to start when AUTH_ENABLED holds any value other than an empty value or true.

title: One verifier and one key source
statement: The code this component emits MUST NOT create a second signature verifier, HTTP client or key refresh task.

title: Startup needs a usable context
statement: The SSO handler this component emits MUST refuse a nil startup context and a canceled startup context.

title: The handler does not own the telemetry runtime
statement: The SSO handler this component emits MUST bind its startup to the process-owned telemetry runtime, and MUST NOT close that runtime.

title: SSO startup telemetry holds no private data
statement: A startup telemetry record from the SSO handler this component emits MUST NOT contain the key file path, the key document or the issuer.

title: Red Hat SSO is a configuration of oidc-auth
statement: On the runtime data path this component MUST be a configuration of oidc-auth (ST-SUP-RC37) with the issuer form and the claims of Red Hat SSO, and MUST NOT be a verifier of its own. The Product owner decided on 2026-11-11 that sign-in on the runtime data path supports any OpenID Connect provider; the new component and rh-sso-auth as its configuration are the orchestrator's design under the owner's delegation. The issuer form is https://<host>/auth/realms/<realm>, the subject claim sub, the tenant claim org_id, which the declared tenancy claim must be, and the algorithm RS256; the key set comes from the discovery document of the issuer, so a key file or another key URL is refused on the runtime data path.

title: Each setting is read once
statement: A generated group MUST read each declared environment name at most once, MUST NOT read another group's name, and MUST NOT enumerate the process environment.

title: A missing value uses its declared default
statement: A generated read MUST use the declared default for a missing variable, and MUST fail when a field has no default.

title: A failed read returns no partial result
statement: A failed read MUST return the zero settings value, and MUST NOT return a field that it already parsed.

title: An error names only the declaration
statement: A configuration error MUST name only the declared group, the declared field and a fixed reason, and MUST NOT contain the input value or the parser error.

title: Each type has explicit rules
statement: A generated read MUST treat an explicitly empty variable as a value instead of a default, MUST refuse invalid UTF-8 and control characters in a string, MUST require signed decimal integers inside their declared bounds, MUST require Go duration syntax inside its declared bounds, and MUST accept only the exact boolean words.

title: Settings stay out of logs
statement: Formatting a settings value MUST redact its contents, and implicit JSON export MUST fail.

title: Reads share no state
statement: A generated read MUST share no state with another read, so concurrent reads stay correct.

title: The loader reads the process environment
statement: The generated loader MUST read the process environment for each declared name, and MUST return the typed value.

title: The client uses only the HTTPS browser origin
statement: The browser client this component emits MUST send every request to the current browser origin, and MUST refuse to start when that origin is not a plain HTTPS origin at the root.

title: Every fetch is same-origin, uncached and unredirected
statement: Every request the client makes MUST use same-origin mode and same-origin credentials, no store, no referrer, and MUST treat a redirect as an error.

title: The client accepts no credential and no arbitrary header
statement: The client MUST NOT accept an API origin, a bearer token, a cookie or an arbitrary request header from application code, and MUST accept only the declared request options.

title: A mutation carries a fresh session token
statement: Before each mutation the client MUST read the session route and supply its session CSRF token, MUST NOT keep that token in a cache, and MUST NOT return it from the public session method.

title: An unauthenticated session stops a mutation
statement: When the session route reports that the viewer is not authenticated, the client MUST refuse the mutation with its reauthentication error and status 401, and MUST NOT send the mutation request.

title: Invalid input makes no request
statement: The client MUST check each path argument, query argument and request body against the contract before it calls fetch, and MUST make no network request when a check fails.

title: A response is checked against the contract
statement: The client MUST check each response against its contract model and MUST refuse a duplicate member, malformed Unicode, a non-finite number, an unsafe integer, an undeclared member and a wrong media type.

title: Each operation is bounded in size, time and number
statement: The client MUST bound a request body to 1 MiB, a response body to 4 MiB and a URL to 8192 characters, MUST end each operation after twenty seconds, MUST permit at most sixteen concurrent operations, and MUST NOT queue or retry.

title: An error carries only fixed codes
statement: An error the client raises MUST carry only a fixed transport code, an HTTP status and an API code that the declaration lists, and MUST NOT carry a response body, a URL, a credential, a reason or an underlying exception message.

title: Login and logout use fixed same-origin routes
statement: The login method MUST navigate to the fixed same-origin login route with a bounded local return path and no fragment, and the console logout MUST use the fixed same-origin logout route.

title: An operation name cannot change an object prototype
statement: The client object this component emits MUST have no prototype, so an operation named after a prototype member cannot change the prototype of another object.

title: A trace context belongs to one operation
statement: A supplied trace context MUST be captured before the operation's first asynchronous step, MUST apply to that operation's session and API requests only, MUST NOT stay on a reused client, and MUST be refused before any request when it is not a valid W3C version 00 value.

title: The emitted declarations type-check under strict TypeScript
statement: The TypeScript declarations this component emits MUST type-check under strict mode, MUST separate request models from response models, and MUST refuse an absent required argument, a wrong body member type, a response-only member in a request and an OAuth credential in the request options.

title: One trusted signer and one pinned pipeline per provider
